messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Dana Park <dana.park@zenvera.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@zenvera.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: lock a 30-min intro — two candidate windows

Hey Dana / Evan — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and two asks below.

Recap (2 min):
- We reviewed your inference pain (latency spikes on peak queries, inconsistent cost per request across models).
- Redwood’s Dedicated mode + prefix caching looked like the closest match to your reliability goals.

Primary ask: lock a 30-minute intro demo so we can walk the technical owners through: runtime behavior, autoscaling profile, and a quick cost/latency comparison using a sample trace you shared.

Candidate windows (PST):
1) Tue Jun 1, 11:00–11:30 AM PT
2) Wed Jun 2, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
(If those don’t work, we can offer Thu Jun 3, 9:00–9:30 AM PT as a fallback.)

Please reply with the preferred slot and who from your side should join. If security or infra want to be in the room, we can include a short appendix on data handling and VPC options.

Attached: MVP-demo-agenda.pdf (quick run of topics — 1 page).

Next steps for us: once you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite, include the mutual action plan, and add a short pre-demo checklist for the infra owner.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0191
Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — good session earlier.

We can do Wed Jun 2, 2:00–2:30 PM PT (option 2) but can you shift 15 minutes later to 2:15–2:45 PM? Our product manager has a standing internal check at 2:00 that’s hard to move.

Evan (cc’d) should join from infra/security to cover networking and encryption questions. Evan — will you be able to join if Karthik pushes to 2:15?

Also, can you include a short summary of what level of environment access you’ll need for the proof-of-concept (e.g., sample traces, small test dataset)? If you have a SOC/controls bridge doc or a short note on data residency, that would be helpful prior to the call.

Appreciate it — Dana

Thanks Dana — 2:15–2:45 PM PT on Wed Jun 2 works on our side. I’ve added Evan, Mina (product/solutions), and Naomi (security) to the thread so we have the right SMEs.

Actions I’ll take now: 
- Send a calendar invite (included: Redwood-demo-invite.ics) for Wed Jun 2, 2:15–2:45 PM PT.
- Attach the mutual action plan and a short pre-demo checklist for infra (mutual-action-plan.xlsx).
- Naomi — I’m looping you in to attach the SOC/controls summary and a 1-page data-residency note we can share ahead of the call.

Dana — quick answers to your question on environment access: for the demo we typically ask for a short sample trace (anonymized) and a small representative dataset (S3 or brief CSV) so we can show cost/latency on something close to your workload. No credentials needed ahead of time — just a temporary read-only link or a paste of a small sample is fine.

If Evan or the security team want a short pre-call sync, Mina and I can make time Tues Jun 1 late afternoon PST for a 20-minute prep. Otherwise we’ll proceed with Wed’s full demo.

Related links: Calendly backup: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30m | Prep doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBqDemoPrepDoc

—
Karthik Iyer
